apple.name: Takuzu Lab
apple.subtitle: Daily binary puzzles
apple.description: Play a daily 4×4 Takuzu puzzle or free 4×4 and 6×6 boards. Rows and columns must balance, avoid three identical numbers in a row, and avoid duplicate completed lines. Use hints, undo, redo, and restart. Progress saves locally.
